content.short: Bondi tokenizes corporate bonds to provide stable, high, and uncorrelated yields onchain.
content.description: Bondi Finance unlocks access to institutional-grade yields by bringing emerging market corporate bonds on-chain. These bonds, typically inaccessible due to $100,000+ minimums, can deliver high yields and exhibit a low correlation to crypto volatility. By investing in Bond Tokens (BTs), users gain stable, fixed-income exposure on USD stablecoins, with potential annual yields reaching up to 20%. Through a seamless, blockchain-powered platform, Bondi makes these opportunities accessible to a broad audience.
content.meta: Bondi enables access to tokenized corporate bonds, delivering stable, high yields onchain. Discover Bondi and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
